University of Massachusetts Bachelor of Science program in Computer Science is accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET. ABET assures quality for degree programs in applied science, computing, engineering, and technology. The program provides a rigorous education in theory and practice of Computer Science in addition to outside science courses. A Bachelor of Science degree can be used as a basis for many jobs in industry or for graduate work in Computer Science and other fields.

University of Massachusetts offer a curriculum stressing software development. It provides training appropriate for students with interests in areas such as cybersecurity, data mining, artificial intelligence, database management, and software engineering. An aptitude for logical reasoning and mathematics is needed to complete the major successfully, partly because designing programs to solve problems requires good problem solving skills and partly because some of the requirements are relatively advanced theoretical Computer Science and mathematics courses.

International Direct

International direct admission is for international students with advanced English-language skills. It focuses on academic, cultural, and professional growth so students can excel in school—and prepare for a successful future.

International direct students receive:

  • Exclusive and rigorous academic coursework
  • Priority access to in-demand courses that fit their interests
  • Guidance from academic advisors and mentors
  • Career development and networking opportunities
  • Intensive classes with domestic students

Bachelor of Science - Entrepreneurship

The Entrepreneurship BS provides students with the knowledge, skills, and mindset needed to launch and grow innovative businesses. Guided by experienced entrepreneurs and business leaders, they will learn how to identify opportunities, create business plans, secure funding, and overcome the challenges of building a start-up or managing a small business.

In this program, students will:

  • Develop problem-solving and leadership skills to create and manage business ventures.
  • Learn how to assess market opportunities, develop business models, and secure funding.
  • Gain hands-on experience through start-up incubators, business competitions, and real-world projects.

Bachelor of Science - Finance

The Finance BS equips students with the knowledge and analytical skills to navigate the complexities of financial markets, investments, and corporate finance. Guided by expert faculty and industry professionals, they will gain a deep understanding of financial decision-making, risk management, and strategic planning, preparing them for a dynamic career in finance.

In this program, students will:

  • Learn key financial concepts, including investment analysis, risk management, and financial modeling.
  • Develop problem-solving and analytical skills to assess financial data and make strategic decisions.
  • Gain real-world experience through case studies, simulations, and hands-on projects.

The Master of Science - Business Analytics program is designed to prepare students for utilizing analytical techniques, methods, and applications for data-driven practices in diverse organizations and enterprises of all sizes.

As businesses become more and more reliant on data-driven strategies, the needs and opportunities for graduates in Business Analytics have grown rapidly. Breakthroughs in data collection, storage, and analysis to uncover and capture business value have fueled this growth, and post-recession companies have recognized this potential and increasingly emphasize data-driven decision-making in their business strategies.

This program covers theories of powerful techniques and quantitative methods in Business Analytics and how they are applied in the real world. The program focuses on using current software tools to study effective techniques of problem formulation, developing solutions with mathematical and algorithmic techniques, and methods for implementing those solutions with technology.

The Master of Science - Business Analytics program offers students a choice of two specializations, Big Data Analytics and Supply Chain Analytics. Each includes a core of analytical courses, elective courses in that specialization, and a capstone course.

University of Massachusetts Boston's MBA is a streamlined 12-course, AACSB-accredited, immersive business program.

Throughout the program, students will develop the necessary skills needed to tackle the most complex business decisions.
82bd:
Whether students aspire to embark on a new business venture, revitalize an established company, or address a pressing social issue—UMass Boston's MBA values their values. Our award-winning program is just 12 courses with no prerequisites and no GRE/GMAT required until further notice. Plus, it's available in both online, in-person, and hybrid formats, and can be completed in as little as one year.

Accreditation. The MBA is a Tier-One, AACSB-accredited program. UMass Boston's College of Management is ranked as a Best Business School by The Princeton Review and a top university by U.S. News and World Report.

Salary. Starting salaries for MBA graduates are 22-40% higher than those of people with only a bachelor's degree. Source: Graduate Management Admission Council 2021 Corporate Recruiters Survey.

Personalization. Students can choose from 11 specializations to customize their MBA—choose from supply chain management, information systems, nonprofit management, international management, and more. Five specializations are available in an online format: accounting, business analytics, digital marketing, finance, and marketing.

Grow their own innovative venture. Apply their invaluable business insights as an analyst. Or, climb their way to the top of the C-suite. These are just a few of the possibilities an MBA offers.

Become a(n):

  • Consultant
  • Investment Banker
  • Business Operations Manager
  • Analyst
  • Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
  • Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
